what: NOAA MRMS MultiSensor QPE 24H Pass 2 ending 12:00Z, at the 0.02 degree squares /rain-radar ships, vs NOAA co-op morning gauges (county rain stations, data/rain/daily). Same day convention as ACIS: a report dated D covers the 24 hours ending that morning; radar ending 12Z on D matched far better than 12Z on D-1 (wet-day median gap 0.12 vs 0.42 in).

wet_days.rule: gauge or radar 0.10 in or more

period_totals.rule: stations reporting every day, gauge total 0.50 in or more
